subject: Launch MAP & staggered enablement cadence for Palisade Systems - post-signature implementation
messages:
From: Emma Dawson <emma.dawson@palisade-sys.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@palisade-sys.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: post-signature MAP + staggered enablement cadence

Hi Neha —

Thanks again for the smooth contracting process. We signed the agreement yesterday and want to lock down a practical mutual action plan that embeds the canary rollout, migration windows, and training cadence into a single timeline. High level asks from our side:

- A two-wave canary (10% then 50%) for the initial 30-day live period
- Low-risk migration window for backend traffic cutover (we’ll provide DB read replicas)
- Training for 3 operator teams (support, SRE, product ops) — half-day workshops + runbooks
- Acceptance criteria metrics (P95 latency, error budget, embed match rate)

Could you share a working MAP artifact and a proposed schedule this week? We’re targeting production acceptance by 2027-07-25.

Attachment: palisade_request_summary.pdf (stub)

Thanks —
Emma Dawson
Director of Platform Operations
Palisade Systems
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Emma Dawson <emma.dawson@palisade-sys.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: post-signature MAP + staggered enablement cadence

Emma —

Great to be live with Palisade. I’ve drafted an initial MAP and embedded the implementation plan below (high-level dates anchored to your target of 2027-07-25). I attached a working spreadsheet (palisade_map_v1.xlsx) and our MAP template. Please review and we’ll sync to finalize.

Summary MAP (proposed):

1) Week 0 — Contract handoff & kickoff (2027-06-21)
   - Introductions: PMs, SRE, CS, Security
   - Walkthrough of acceptance criteria and data access needs

2) Week 1–2 — Preflight & eval (2027-06-22 to 2027-07-05)
   - Shared evaluation harness: sample workloads, latency/throughput profiles
   - Quantization and model variant recommendations for cost/latency tradeoffs
   - Security questionnaire & evidence (we’ll provice SOC2 artefacts if needed)

3) Week 3 — Canary wave 1 (10% traffic) (2027-07-06 to 2027-07-12)
   - Monitoring: P95 latency, token cost delta, error rate thresholds
   - Runbook dry-run with support team
   - Go/no-go gate after 72 hours

4) Week 4 — Expanded canary (50% traffic) + training (2027-07-13 to 2027-07-19)
   - Operator workshops: half-day sessions (support, SRE, product ops)
   - Begin migration rehearsals for read-only traffic cutover

5) Week 5 — Final cutover & acceptance (target prod on 2027-07-25)
   - Staged DB switch: midnight maintenance window; rollback path defined
   - Post-cutover 7-day monitoring window; acceptance sign-off

Technical/operational asks from Palisade (to confirm):
- Which endpoints will be in scope for canary waves?
- A list of owner contacts for each operator group
- Expected average and 95th percentile request sizes (tokens/templates)

Attachments included: palisade_map_v1.xlsx, redwood_map_template.pdf, SOW_Palisade_v1.docx

I’ll propose a 30-minute kickoff on Monday (2027-06-21). Does 10am PT work for your team?

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, emma.dawson@palisade-sys.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: post-signature MAP + staggered enablement cadence

Neha / Emma —

Quick technical notes to bake into the MAP:

- Canary routing: we'll implement header-based routing + a token flag so Palisade can control percent by service. For 10% wave we prefer sampling at the edge rather than sticky sessions.
- KV cache warm-up: plan a 24-hour priming period prior to the 10% canary so heavy-tail prompts hit cache as expected.
- Resource sizing: initial dedicated pool (2x A100-equivalent) with burst allowance; if P95 latency exceeds 300ms we open a scaling event.
- Fallbacks: plan for immediate failover to smaller quantized variant if cost/latency regressions occur during the first 72 hours.

I’ll add these to the workbook and flag gate criteria. We should also capture expected token counts per route in the evaluation harness.

-marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emma Dawson <emma.dawson@palisade-sys.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: post-signature MAP + staggered enablement cadence — Training slots

Emma —

Confirmed: we can run three half-day workshops on the week of 2027-07-13. Proposed slots (all PT):
- Support team: Tue 2027-07-13 09:00–13:00
- SRE team: Wed 2027-07-14 09:00–13:00
- Product operations: Thu 2027-07-15 09:00–13:00

Each session: 60m of system architecture & fallback patterns, 60m hands-on with the canary controls in staging, 60m runbook tabletop + Q&A. We’ll deliver a runbook PDF and a short checklist for your on-call rotation.

Can you confirm the attendee lists and preferred tools (Zoom/MSTeams)? We’ll build calendar invites and include the runbook as an attachment.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Engineering
Redwood Inference
